claims.summary: The V0.16.94 production replay passed its release boundary and then exposed a deterministic post-sync Agent source-answer failure.
Smart Sync preserved canonical evidence while replacing a mutable Course Map display citation, and the Agent incorrectly depended only on the display field.
Assigned-source answers use the trusted canonical CourseGraph ledger also consumed by package export.
The live CourseGraph travels from the workspace through the chat panel and router into Scion's local answer capability.
A production-shaped regression requires both official Lesson 3 W3C links and the requested Lesson 4 remediation connection after display citations are absent.
The patch changes Agent evidence continuity only and adds no model, compiler-output, instructor, factual, accessibility, classroom, or paid-model claim.
